# Deep Sky Test

> Your Door to the Cosmos

Professional Grade Astronomical Data at your Fingertips

Every picture is shown with the record AstroTracker keeps of how it was made: integration per filter and per night, subs kept, the telescope and camera.

## Pages

- [Gallery](https://blew676.github.io/gallery-test/gallery/): 114 finished pictures, 4,005 hours of integration.
- [Telescopes](https://blew676.github.io/gallery-test/telescopes/): the telescopes behind the pictures.
- [About](https://blew676.github.io/gallery-test/about/): the person behind the pictures.

## About

Test site for DSD
